_1_about_this_file: HOW THIS FILE IS LOADED. BMM tries four sources and stops at the first that answers: (1) https://bettercommunity.ch/api/assets/links.json — edit THIS one, under BetterCommunity → Admin → Downloads & assets; (2) the copy on GitHub; (3) this bundled file; (4) built-in defaults in links-config.ts. Editing the bundled copy only reaches installs that cannot read 1 or 2. Full reference: frontend/assets/LINKS.md
_2_catalogues: CATALOGUES AND LISTS. What the browser screens read. Point any of these at a tunnel (cloudflared/ngrok) to test against a BetterCommunity that is not the production domain.
_2b_catalogue_lists: Any catalogue value above may be a single URL OR an array of URLs, e.g. "theme_catalog": ["https://a/catalog.json", "https://b/catalog.json"]. BMM reads them through catalogSources() and merges every source that answers; a bad entry degrades to the next and never throws. An empty "" (or []) disables that kind.
_3_updates: UPDATES. autoupdate_api is tried first; autoupdate_api_fallback only if it is unreachable or rate-limited (GitHub allows 60 unauthenticated calls per hour PER IP, which a shared address can exhaust without you). A 404 does NOT fall back — it means there is genuinely no release. BCWEB serves the same JSON shape as GitHub but lists releases at <base>/releases while GitHub lists at <base>; BMM handles both. Set the fallback to "" to disable it.
_4_telemetry: TELEMETRY (opt-in). analytics_key is a PUBLIC ingest key: it only permits SUBMITTING telemetry and already ships inside the app. Keeping both here means the collector can move, or the key rotate, without waiting for a BMM release. EMPTY analytics_endpoint = events stay buffered locally and nothing leaves the machine.
_5_community: COMMUNITY LINKS. WARNING: of these, only `kofi` is actually read by the app. github_repo, discord, reddit, ed_forum, kofi_community and bettercommunity are hardcoded in frontend/index.html, so editing them here changes nothing a user sees. Kept for now because deleting them, or wiring index.html to this registry, is a decision rather than a cleanup — see LINKS.md.
_6_discord_rpc: DISCORD RICH PRESENCE, read on the Rust side (commands/discord.rs). Button 1 = "Website" (its URL gets ?creator=<id> appended at runtime), button 2 = "GitHub". BoutonRPC1 picks which WebSiteRPC link (1 or 2), BoutonRPC2 picks which github_RPC link. These six are the only keys absent from the BmmLinks TypeScript interface, because no TypeScript reads them.
